ns2:course.label: Management Seminar
ns2:course.description: Addresses production and management issues surrounding Theater Department and KCPA productions. Guest speakers provide professional points of view on various management topics. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 undergraduate or 6 graduate hours.
